verdict.summary: The change correctly separates execution of fuzz/PR-authored code from the job holding write permissions, disables persisted checkout credentials in the execution job, transfers the randomized-failure log via an artifact, and limits the elevated filer job to failed schedule or push-to-main runs. The replay guard fails closed for empty or absent corpora while exempting randomized mode, and its hermetic self-test covers both rejection and acceptance paths. Untrusted log content is fence-defused at both the reader and rendering boundary, with a non-vacuous round-trip self-test. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the diff.
